chapter_seo_title: Green Ox Town: Han Li Arrives & the Sect-Gang Conflict
chapter_meta_description: Han Li arrives in Green Ox Town and meets his third uncle. As he awaits the Seven Mysteries Sect's messenger, the history of the sect and its rivalry with the Wild Wolf Gang is revealed.
og_title: Entering Green Ox Town: A Martial World Takes Shape
